title: Verify Fiber Optic Port Dust Cover
description: Ensure transceivers are clean and protective dust caps removed before insertion.
violation: Inserting fiber cable with intact dust cap into active QSFP slot.

title: Dual Redundant PSU Grounding
description: Attach dual-lug ground wire to the rack chassis ground post.
violation: Powering server chassis without verified rack grounding.

title: Engage Primary 100G Trunk Uplink
description: Click latching mechanism on Port 1 until acoustic click is confirmed.
violation: Forcing optical connector without aligning keyed notch.
